title: Kuro Umeshu Plum Nic Salts 10ml E-Liquid  By Riot
description: Kuro Umeshu Plum Nic Salt E-Liquid by Riot Labs offers a deeply layered and sophisticated vaping experience inspired by traditional Japanese beverage culture. This expertly crafted blend accurately captures the authentic, rich taste of Japanese Plum liqueur to deliver a satisfying, dark and fruity base. To complement the initial depth, warm notes of Brown Sugar provide a smooth and lingering sweetness, while a crisp bite of Green Apple on the exhale adds a refreshing contrast. The result is a superbly balanced profile that offers a mature, nuanced alternative to standard fruit e-liquids. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The versatile 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. Kuro Nicotine Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The wider Kuro collection by Riot Labs takes inspiration from modern Japanese food and drink culture to offer a uniquely crafted range of e-liquids. Moving beyond standard profiles, the collection invites vapers to explore premium blends such as the delicately layered Momo Fuji, the zesty Tokyo Mule, or the complex, floral notes of Sakura Nights. Each carefully balanced e-liquid provides a distinct flavour journey for those seeking a highly original, premium vape.
